package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"net"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	mysql "github.com/go-sql-driver/mysql"
	"github.com/talent-assessment/refactored/internal/config"
)

func fail() { fmt.Println("STAGING_BOOTSTRAP_BLOCKED"); os.Exit(1) }

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 6 || os.Geteuid() != 0 {
		fail()
	}
	mode, schema, binary, cwd, pid := os.Args[1], os.Args[2], os.Args[3], os.Args[4], os.Args[5]
	pattern := `^mng_guard_audit_test_[a-f0-9]{16}$`
	if mode == "lock" {
		pattern = `^mng_source_lock_test_[a-f0-9]{16}$`
	}
	if !regexp.MustCompile(pattern).MatchString(schema) || !filepath.IsAbs(binary) || !filepath.IsAbs(cwd) || !regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9]+$`).MatchString(pid) {
		fail()
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile("/proc/" + pid + "/environ")
	if err != nil {
		fail()
	}
	for _, item := range strings.Split(string(raw), "\x00") {
		if key, value, ok := strings.Cut(item, "="); ok {
			if os.Setenv(key, value) != nil {
				fail()
			}
		}
	}
	if os.Getenv("REPORT_EFFECTIVE_ENV") != "staging" || os.Chdir("/opt/talent-assessment") != nil {
		fail()
	}
	log.SetOutput(io.Discard)
	cfg := config.Load()
	dc, err := mysql.ParseDSN(cfg.Mysql.DSN)
	if err != nil || dc.DBName != "element" || dc.Net != "tcp" || (dc.Addr != "127.0.0.1:3306" && dc.Addr != "localhost:3306") || cfg.Jwt.Secret == "" {
		fail()
	}
	dc.User, dc.Passwd, dc.Net, dc.Addr, dc.DBName = "root", "", "unix", "/var/run/mysqld/mysqld.sock", schema
	dc.ParseTime, dc.MultiStatements, dc.InterpolateParams = true, false, false
	dc.Timeout, dc.ReadTimeout, dc.WriteTimeout = 10*time.Second, 15*time.Second, 15*time.Second
	name := "^TestManagementTraitsGuardAuditMySQLStagingExternal$"
	var relay net.Listener
	if mode == "lock" {
		name = "^TestManagementTraitsSourceLockMySQLExternalUpdate$"
		relay, err = net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
		if err != nil {
			fail()
		}
		defer relay.Close()
		go func() {
			for {
				client, e := relay.Accept()
				if e != nil {
					return
				}
				go func() {
					defer client.Close()
					server, e := net.DialTimeout("unix", "/var/run/mysqld/mysqld.sock", 10*time.Second)
					if e != nil {
						return
					}
					defer server.Close()
					var wg sync.WaitGroup
					wg.Add(1)
					go func() { defer wg.Done(); _, _ = io.Copy(server, client); server.Close() }()
					_, _ = io.Copy(client, server)
					client.Close()
					wg.Wait()
				}()
			}
		}()
		dc.Net, dc.Addr = "tcp", relay.Addr().String()
	}
	cmd := exec.Command(binary, "-test.run", name, "-test.v", "-test.timeout", "150s")
	cmd.Dir, cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = cwd, os.Stdout, os.Stderr
	env := make([]string, 0)
	for _, item := range os.Environ() {
		key, _, _ := strings.Cut(item, "=")
		if strings.HasPrefix(key, "MNG_") || key == "MYSQL_DSN" || key == "JWT_SECRET" {
			continue
		}
		env = append(env, item)
	}
	env = append(env, "JWT_SECRET="+cfg.Jwt.Secret, "MYSQL_DSN="+dc.FormatDSN())
	if mode == "lock" {
		env = append(env, "MNG_SOURCE_LOCK_MYSQL_DSN="+dc.FormatDSN())
	} else {
		env = append(env, "MNG_GUARD_AUDIT_MYSQL_DSN="+dc.FormatDSN(), "MNG_GUARD_AUDIT_MYSQL_SCHEMA="+schema)
		if mode == "schema" {
			env = append(env, "MNG_STAGING_SCHEMA_ONLY=1")
		} else if mode != "post" {
			fail()
		}
	}
	cmd.Env = env
	if cmd.Run() != nil {
		fail()
	}
	fmt.Println("STAGING_BOOTSTRAP_CHILD_PASS", mode)
}
